rationale: The user explicitly chose to retain generic Kajkavian on 2026-09-06. Glottolog kajk1237 describes the spoken language, while the pinned ISO table names kjv Kaikavian Literary Language (historical). The registration authors distinguish the literary norm from the generic dialect group: https://kajkavski-jezik.eu/en/kajkavian-iso-639-3-language-code/ . The Glottolog cross-reference to kjv is narrower supporting evidence, never an exact ISO identity; all generic source forms remain hr-x-kajkav.

User-approved preservation of generic Estonian et / est. The pinned IANA macrolanguage memberships include ekk and vro. Glottolog places esto1258 (ekk) and sout2679 (vro) in different Finnic branches; their common broader ancestor is finn1317. Q9072 is retained for generic Estonian, while its narrower P1394 claim does not establish an exact Glottolog equivalence.
